source.name: The Order of Divine Service for Public Worship, the Administration of the Sacraments and Other Rites and Ceremonies, and a Selection from the Daily Offices, Compiled from Ancient and Modern Devotions
source.author: W. E. Orchard (compiler)
source.publisher: Humphrey Milford, Oxford University Press, London
source.note: Public domain in the US (published 1921); Orchard died 1955. Its "Simple Observance of the Lord's Supper" (pp. 116–118) supplies the eucharistic versicles, which are scripture in the Revised Version arranged by Orchard.
